'''Pendari''' was an object<ref name="GG11" /> situated in the [[Pendari system/Legends|eponymous star system]], a part of the [[Vensensor sector/Legends|Vensensor sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Region" /> Pendari lay along the major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] between the [[Kinyen system/Legends|Kinyen]] and [[Tar Morden system/Legends|Tar Morden systems]].<ref name="EA" />

Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Pendari was the site of a Class IB military [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The facility's output was limited to [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser-type]] ships.<ref name="EW" /> Not long before a [[Raid on the Pendari shipyards|raid]] on the Imperial [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] at Pendari, the Alliance paid a [[Unidentified Pendari slicer|slicer]] an undisclosed amount to break into the Imperial base command [[Computer/Legends|computer]]<ref name="GG11" /> and discover the refitting schedule of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Gallant Sun]]''.<ref name="cswe">{{CSWECite|I|316|''Gallant Sun''}}</ref> The slicer was successful, and the information obtained allowed the Rebels to know the precise time the ''Gallant Sun'' would be in space dock for repairs. As a result, the Alliance was able to destroy the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] with minimal casualties.<ref name="GG11" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pendari was first mentioned in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG11" /> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Pendari system/Legends|Pendari star system]] and the object itself in grid square K-16.<ref name="EA" />
